segments.an5.164:1.1: [a. ni.5.65] Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi … pe …“pañcahi, āvuso, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃsājīvo sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
segments.an5.164:1.4: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti, sīlasampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti;
segments.an5.164:1.5: attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti, samādhisampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti;
segments.an5.164:1.6: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, paññāsampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti;
segments.an5.164:1.7: attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti, vimuttisampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti;
segments.an5.164:1.8: attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti.
segments.an5.164:1.9: Imehi kho, āvuso, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃsājīvo sabrahmacārīnan”ti.

lines: Dutiye āghāto paṭivinayati ettha, etehīti vā āghātapaṭivinayā.
Yadi hi tassa anto bhaveyya,“pilotikā”ti saṅkhaṃ na gaccheyya.
Visabhāgavedanuppattiyā kakaceneva iriyāpathapavattinivāraṇena chindanto ābādhati pīḷetīti ābādho, so assa atthīti ābādhiko.
Pasannabhāvena udakassa acchabhāvo veditabboti āha “acchodakāti pasannodakā”ti.
Tanukameva salilaṃ visesato sītalaṃ, na bahalāti āha “tanusītasalilā”ti.
